Adobe | Senior Software Engineer (Behance – Graph & Recommendations) | $173,500 – $331,050 base (US) | Full-time | New York, NY (onsite) / Remote-friendly (US)

Behance is Adobe’s network for creatives. We’re hiring a senior backend/graph engineer to own and evolve recommended content, creator discovery, and the social networking graph across Behance and other flagship Adobe products. You will:

- Design, build, and operate the Neo4j-based graph behind personalization, discovery, and monetization.

- Lead new recommendation surfaces (For You, Boost/Pro, hiring/search) end-to-end with product and design partners.

- Mentor engineers, drive architecture reviews, and dig into hard production problems where graph + recommendations really matter.

Email me at jbertouch@adobe.com with “HN – Behance” in the subject, or apply here: https://adobe.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/external_experienced/job...
